purpose: Exploratory paired benchmark: does the accessibility skill (frozen at f7fb27e) change measurable keyboard-task completion on a real, fully-offline application. NOT ACT calibration; NOT a general effectiveness result — one pair.

target.install: npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund in examples/javascript-es5 (the two locked production deps: todomvc-app-css 2.4.2, todomvc-common 1.0.5); raw index/src runs, no build
target.serve: repository root on 127.0.0.1:<port>; app at /examples/javascript-es5/ so /learn.json resolves
target.offline_evidence: baseline/run-3-node22: all requests http://127.0.0.1:8388/* — zero external attempts (see baseline/run-3-node22/report.json network_attempts). The api.github.com sidebar call in todomvc-common/base.js did not fire (learn.json entry has no issueLink for this example).

treatment.skill_source: treatment/ dependency-complete bundle verbatim at f7fb27e4e9e36ccc0733b09d0af10fb9148a5d49: SKILL.md, checklist.md, audit.mjs, README.md, templates/{README.md,wcag-2.2-aa.csv}, docs/RELEASE-READINESS.md, tests-validateurs/assertions.mjs at original relative paths; sha256 in treatment/provenance.json; worker env = pinned root pnpm deps (playwright 1.63.0, axe-core 4.13.0)

control.skill: none — identical task requirements, neutral prompt

identical: general tools/environment (both arms get the pinned root toolkit)

worker_config.mode_recording: requested devin_mode and the returned/effective mode/model metadata are recorded separately in arms/<arm>/session-meta.json. If 'lite' is rejected or the two workers come back with different effective modes, dispatch STOPS and the asymmetry is reported — no silent substitution.
worker_config.interpretation: Lite-preset pilot only. The preset name does not establish underlying model weights; results say nothing about a known weaker model.
worker_config.slots: at most 2 worker sessions, sequential acceptable
worker_config.budgets: 20-minute wall-clock per arm measured from platform worker-session creation — INCLUDES all worker-side setup/waits/remediation; no pause or reset. Parent-only protocol preparation precedes creation and is outside the clock. Max 3 correction rounds; partial patch preserved on timeout. Self-reported minutes are labelled unverified.
worker_config.provisioning: provisioning/worker-layout.md — frozen file layout + commands identical for both arms; treatment adds only skill/ bundle

evaluation_contract.runner: harness/evaluate.sh <patch.diff|-> <outdir> — fresh mktemp clone -> pin checkout -> optional git apply --check -> npm ci (omit=dev, ignore-scripts) -> serve repo root -> harness/audit.todo.mjs
evaluation_contract.input_hashes: scope.json statesHash = sha256(task-checks.mjs + net-policy.mjs); patch sha256 recorded in eval-status.env
evaluation_contract.keyboard_rule: Only real keyboard events (Tab walking + Enter/Space/F2/Escape via page.keyboard) count as credited actions. DOM focus()/programmatic click()/pre-seeded outcomes do not count.
evaluation_contract.discovery_rule: The evaluator discovers a keyboard edit affordance by trying, in order: (a) a control with accessible name matching /edit/i (checked with @playwright/test toHaveAccessibleName — no in-page approximation), (b) F2 inside the item, (c) Enter/Space on a non-checkbox descendant of the item. This is a CUSTOM EVALUATION CONTRACT, not a normative WCAG requirement: WCAG/APG requires keyboard operability but does not mandate one specific shortcut or markup. Both arms receive this contract text verbatim.
evaluation_contract.identity_oracles: Items tracked by data-id + label text; per-item checkbox.checked AND li.classList consistency required (contradiction = FAIL); ancestor-aware visibility via checkVisibility({checkOpacity,checkVisibilityCSS}); filter assertions compare exact visible identities; task3 survivors must keep id+text identity across toggle-all and Completed filter.
evaluation_contract.focus_oracles: After edit commit/cancel, focus must land on a visible semantic control (button/input/a/[role]/[tabindex]) inside the SAME item — never BODY, never a hidden element.
evaluation_contract.persistence_note: Upstream store.js uses module-local MemoryStorage — reload resets items to empty. Recorded in baseline as expected behavior (reloadReset, unscored); persistence is NOT a required feature and is never scored.
not_tested: assistive technology / screen readers (live-region DOM metadata is a semantic signal, not SR-announcement proof)
pointer-only users beyond the preserved-dblclick check

controls.location: harness/fixtures/ctrl-*.html — SYNTHETIC evaluator-owned pages; not app code, not worker output
positive: ctrl-slow-filter (render lands 700ms after hashchange — proves rendered-outcome waits)
controls.cli_contracts: harness/test-cli.mjs spawns the real audit.todo.mjs: healthy positive (exit 0, zero page errors, zero blocked), page-error-only and external-request-only fixtures (exit != 0, fatal names the correct branch independently), 404 navigation (exit != 0), preseeded stale report/scope replaced by fresh run ids
controls.gate: pnpm test:task-pilot = test-controls.mjs + test-cli.mjs + test-serve.mjs (path-traversal regression, cherry-picked 8b42ff7)
controls.rule: controls exercise the SAME published task functions and the real CLI; outcomes are never weakened to make the evaluator pass

baseline.prior_runs: baseline run-1 (4da572d) and run-2 (820e05e) were executed on a dirty working tree / Node 20 — historical evidence only, viewable at immutable commits: https://github.com/titoude/accessibilite-conformite/tree/3e863959bcb1dac87de41e914c80d41db78ced25/benchmarks/task-pilot/baseline run-3-node22 is the committed-head accepted baseline

result.task2_keyboard_edit: FAIL — upstream binds editing to dblclick only; no keyboard affordance discovered
result.task3_toggle_clear: FAIL — Space on .toggle-all checks the control itself without completing any item (toggleAllCheckedWithoutEffect); downstream count/filter checks fail
result.axe_initial: heading-order x1, landmark-one-main x1, region x1 (0-item state)
result.axe_final: heading-order x1, label x1, region x3 (post-task state)

baseline.consistency_with_reviewer: matches the reviewer's independent baseline (zero external requests, MemoryStorage reload reset, toggle-all self-check, axe label rule present post-items) and their Windows Node24 replay of task PASS/FAIL/FAIL + axe counts

deviations_and_limits: n=1 pair — no causal claim, no generalization
custom discovery contract is not a normative WCAG requirement
the with-skill arm of pilot 1 self-reported violations that differed from replay measurement — the same risk applies here; only evaluator replay counts
skill-only additions vs. control: the treatment/ bundle files; no other setup difference
